description: Query rows of a layer or table: a dataset's layer (`layer_id` from describe_dataset), a map library layer (`layer_id` "lib:..." from search_library, e.g. the geology polygons in a box or of one rock type) or a table (`table_id`). Optional `bbox` (minx,miny,maxx,maxy in WGS84 degrees), `filters` (list of {field, op, value}; op is eq/ne/lt/lte/gt/gte for numeric fields, eq/ne/contains for text), `fields` (attribute names to return), `limit` (max 1000; 200 with geometry on a library layer) and `cursor` from a previous page. Set `geometry` true to include GeoJSON geometry. Returns the features with their attributes; a library layer also gives the count of all matches and its field names.

table_id.description: For table datasets (CSV / XLSX); use instead of layer_id.

name: query_features
title: Query a dataset's features
